Token showcase

Infragistics Design System. Every value on this page is read from the built stylesheets.

Colour

Site code uses the semantic tokens. Each name says what the colour is for.

Action

  • --igd-color-action-defaultThe engine’s primary seed itself (--ig-primary-seed), not a fitted shade. Every action: primary CTA fill (label color-action-on), in-page links and eyebrows on color-surface-page and color-surface-tint. Contrast 5.25:1 on color-surface-page, 4.83:1 on color-surface-tint, 5.25:1 on color-surface-page, 4.83:1 on color-surface-tint, 5.25:1 on color-surface-page.
  • --igd-color-action-hoverLink hover on light surfaces (colour shift only, no underline). Contrast 5.41:1 on color-surface-page.
  • --igd-color-action-fill-hoverFilled-button hover: the primary fill darkens to this and nothing else changes.
  • --igd-color-action-activeInline link press state on light surfaces. Contrast 8.8:1 on color-surface-page.
  • --igd-color-action-textThe action colour when it is text, an icon or a thin line on a light surface: links, eyebrows, outline and ghost button labels, focus outlines. Equal to color-action-default by default. A lighter seed is darkened until it reads on color-surface-page (AA).
  • --igd-color-action-onLabel and icon colour on color-action-default fills: black or white, whichever reads on the fill (the engine’s adaptive contrast). Contrast 5.25:1 on color-action-default.
  • --igd-color-action-subtleTinted capsule fill behind color-action-default text. Live: color-action-default at opacity-subtle.
  • --igd-color-action-subtle-borderBorder of the color-action-subtle capsule. Live: color-action-default at opacity-strong.

Text

  • --igd-color-text-headingHeadlines h1–h6 on color-surface-page and the catalog band. Contrast 17.79:1 on color-surface-page.
  • --igd-color-text-primaryStrong text and secondary-button labels on color-surface-page; the body default in base styles. Contrast 13.8:1 on color-surface-page.
  • --igd-color-text-secondaryBody and lead copy, utility-bar text and nav triggers at rest, on color-surface-page and color-surface-subtle. Contrast 7.53:1 on color-surface-page, 7.16:1 on color-surface-subtle, 7.53:1 on color-surface-page, 6.74:1 on color-surface-muted.
  • --igd-color-text-uiUI text — nav, buttons, list rows, chips — on color-surface-page. Contrast 10.43:1 on color-surface-page, 9.92:1 on color-surface-subtle.
  • --igd-color-text-mutedMuted copy, nano labels, card descriptions and catalog counts; body copy never goes lighter. Contrast 4.94:1 on color-surface-page, 4.7:1 on color-surface-subtle, 4.94:1 on color-surface-page, 4.94:1 on color-surface-card, 4.55:1 on color-surface-tint, 4.94:1 on color-surface-page.
  • --igd-color-text-inverseText on color-surface-inverse. Engine step 900 of the dark palette's gray ramp. Contrast 17.25:1 on color-surface-inverse.
  • --igd-color-text-inverse-mutedStat-badge labels and muted copy on color-surface-inverse. Engine step 400 of the dark palette's gray ramp. Contrast 7.17:1 on color-surface-inverse.

Surface

  • --igd-color-surface-pagePage background; flat.
  • --igd-color-surface-heroTop of the hero wash (gradient-hero).
  • --igd-color-surface-subtleAlternating section bands, BrowserFrame title bar, callout strips and chips at rest.
  • --igd-color-surface-cardMarketing card fill.
  • --igd-color-surface-tintSoft blue fill: tinted chips, callouts, the catalog band, release strip at rest and monogram badges.
  • --igd-color-surface-inverse-raisedThe lightest dark surface: where a dark area lifts towards the light, such as the start of the footer gradient. Engine step 200 of the dark palette's surface ramp.
  • --igd-color-surface-inverse-sunkenThe darkest dark surface: the deepest part of a dark area, such as the end of the footer gradient. Engine step 900 of the dark palette's surface ramp.
  • --igd-color-surface-inverseThe one dark treatment: stat badges, table header and dark stat panels (the engine dark-variant surface). Engine step 500 of the dark palette's surface ramp.
  • --igd-color-surface-tint-strongRelease strip on hover; also the open nav trigger.
  • --igd-color-surface-muted"Coming soon" pill fill.

Border

  • --igd-color-border-defaultHairline border on cards, chips and tinted chips; secondary-button border.
  • --igd-color-border-subtleHairline under the nav; default catalog-card border.
  • --igd-color-border-controlBorder of a form control (input, checkbox) on light surfaces. 3:1 against the page, the WCAG 1.4.11 minimum. Contrast 4.94:1 on color-surface-page.
  • --igd-color-border-accentBlue-tinted borders: soft blue fills, outline buttons and the release label.

Accent

  • --igd-color-accent-primaryBrand accent: gradient start, icon tile fill, glow source. Not a CTA fill and never text on white.
  • --igd-color-accent-primary-hoverHover step of color-accent-primary.
  • --igd-color-accent-primary-activePress state step of color-accent-primary.
  • --igd-color-accent-secondaryGradient partner to color-accent-primary and the AI marker. Never a fill on its own.
  • --igd-color-accent-inverseOn-dark accent only: stat numbers on color-surface-inverse. Never on white. Engine step 200 of the sky palette. Contrast 8.24:1 on color-surface-inverse.
  • --igd-color-accent-inverse-altOn-dark accent only: performance stat numbers on color-surface-inverse. Never on white. Engine step 200 of the teal palette. Contrast 8.19:1 on color-surface-inverse.

Link

  • --igd-color-link-utilityLinks in the utility row above the nav, on color-surface-page. Contrast 5.41:1 on color-surface-page, 5.14:1 on color-surface-subtle.
  • --igd-color-link-utility-hoverUtility-row link hover.
  • --igd-color-link-inverseInline links on dark surfaces (color-surface-inverse). Engine step 200 of the sky palette. Contrast 8.24:1 on color-surface-inverse.
  • --igd-color-link-inverse-hoverHover of color-link-inverse: colour shift only. Engine step 900 of the dark palette's gray ramp.

Focus

  • --igd-color-focus-defaultKeyboard focus outline on light surfaces, focus-ring-width at focus-ring-offset, :focus-visible only. Contrast 5.25:1 on color-surface-page.
  • --igd-color-focus-inverseKeyboard focus outline inside a data-on-dark section. Engine step 100 of the sky palette. Contrast 11.17:1 on color-surface-inverse, 11.17:1 on color-surface-inverse.

Feedback

  • --igd-color-feedback-error-defaultValidation text and border on light surfaces. Contrast 7.33:1 on color-surface-page, 6.97:1 on color-surface-subtle.
  • --igd-color-feedback-error-inverseValidation text and border on the dark footer. Contrast 5.28:1 on color-surface-inverse-raised.

Other

  • --igd-color-icon-subtleThe caret in the nav row (decorative, below the 3:1 icon floor, kept as in the source). Contrast 2.59:1 on color-surface-page.
  • --igd-color-emphasis-borderBorder of emphasised cards and the release strip at rest. Live: color-accent-primary at opacity-heavy.
  • --igd-color-emphasis-ringInner ring of the release strip at rest. Live: color-accent-primary at opacity-soft.
  • --igd-color-emphasis-ring-hoverInner ring of the release strip on hover. Live: color-accent-primary at opacity-strong.
  • --igd-color-overlay-scrimPage dimmer behind an open nav panel. Live: color-surface-inverse at opacity-strong.

Type

Fifteen roles. The readout under a class is its size, line height and weight as rendered right now: resize the window, or pick a type set.

.igd-type-display-lgEnterprise UI Components, Accelerated by AIHomepage hero only, in color-text-heading. (was display-h1; engine slot h1)
.igd-type-display-mdMeet the Industry’s Fastest Data GridSection heads, in color-text-heading. (was display-h2; engine slot h2)
.igd-type-display-smSales DashboardSub-section and panel heads; color-text-inverse on dark. There is no h7. (was display-h3; engine slot h3)
.igd-type-stat100K+ RowsStat badge values: color-accent-inverse or color-accent-inverse-alt on color-surface-inverse, color-text-muted on light; newsletter title. (was display-stat; engine slot h4)
.igd-type-title-mdIgnite UIProduct names in a catalog card, in color-text-heading. (was product-name; engine slot h5)
.igd-type-title-smQuery BuilderCard titles, sentence case, in color-text-heading — body face, not the display face. (was card-title; engine slot h6)
.igd-type-leadBuild enterprise applications with 300+ framework agnostic UI components.Lead under an h1 or h2, in color-text-secondary. (was body-lead; engine slot subtitle-1)
.igd-type-label-lgIntroducing Ignite UI 2026Hero button label and callout titles. (was callout-title; engine slot subtitle-2)
.igd-type-body-lgEnterprise-grade virtualization renders 100,000 rows without lag.Running prose, in color-text-secondary. (was body-text; engine slot body-1)
.igd-type-body-mdAdvanced virtualization and hundreds of built-in features.Nav, buttons and list rows, in color-text-ui. (was body-ui; engine slot body-2)
.igd-type-label-mdStart Free TrialButton and CTA labels. (was button; engine slot button)
.igd-type-body-smVisual query composition with nested groups.Captions, card descriptions and table detail copy. (was body-caption; engine slot caption)
.igd-type-eyebrowDEVELOPER TOOLSEyebrows: ALL CAPS, in color-action-default. (was eyebrow; engine slot overline)
.igd-type-body-xsNorth American Sales: 1-800-231-8588Micro text: utility bar, legal copy, chips. (was body-micro)
.igd-type-body-2xsFastest gridBadge sublabels and nano meta labels (color-text-muted). (was body-nano)

Radius

Each role has a design value and a range it stays within.

  • --igd-radius-fullPills: every action, chip and framework selector. Fully round on controls up to 64px tall; never sharper than 4px. Range 4px to 32px.
  • --igd-nav-panel-radiusFlared top corners of an open nav panel. Range 0px to 30px.
  • --igd-radius-xlEmphasis and catalog cards. Never a circle: capped at 28px. Range 4px to 28px.
  • --igd-radius-lgMarketing cards and media frames. Capped at 24px. Range 0px to 24px.
  • --igd-radius-mdIcon tiles, stat badges and nav link rows. Capped at 16px so a tile never becomes a circle. Range 4px to 16px.
  • --igd-radius-smSmall elements and the monogram badge. Range 2px to 12px.
  • --igd-radius-xsOSS tag and checkbox. Range 2px to 8px.

Shadow

Built from the engine's elevations. The accent shadows take the action colour.

  • --igd-shadow-noneCards at rest — flat; a card is defined by its hairline color-border-default. Engine elevation 0.
  • --igd-shadow-raisedCard hover: cards lift shadow only, no translate or scale. Engine elevation 4.
  • --igd-shadow-accent-lgPrimary CTA and its hover (no shadow change on hover). Engine elevation 16 tinted with color-action-default.
  • --igd-shadow-accent-smFramework pill hover — the only hover change on a pill. Engine elevation 1 tinted with color-action-default.
  • --igd-shadow-overlayScreenshots inside a BrowserFrame. Engine elevation 22.
  • --igd-shadow-floatingFloating stat badges. Engine elevation 16.
  • --igd-shadow-accent-mdBundle cards with the gradient border. Engine elevation 13 tinted with color-action-default.
